summary: End-to-end testing of Scan & Stock Dentaire (MVP first iteration). 18/18 backend pytest cases passed (CRUD for products/categories/suppliers, movements, scan flow, orders, alerts, dashboard, seed). Frontend navigation, dashboard metrics, scanner auto-focus+scan, inventory list + product dialog, alerts tabs with correct counts, and order dialog all verified via Playwright. No critical bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (559 lines) is still a single-file monolith; acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routers (products/suppliers/categories/orders/movements/seed) if the project grows beyond 700 lines.
clean_doc() util is defined but unused because MongoDB queries already use projection {"_id":0} everywhere — good, safe to remove the helper.
/api/scan does not persist Movement.reason when payload.reason is empty — it defaults to 'Scan entrée'/'Scan sortie' which is fine, just confirm intended.

Order status transition does not guard against double-receive (receiving an already-received order would re-add stock). Consider checking existing['status'] != 'received' before re-incrementing quantities.
2x console 404s on page load (likely favicon.ico / manifest.json assets). Cosmetic only — no functional impact.
seed_data_creation: Demo data already seeded by E1 (10 products, 3 suppliers, 5 categories). /api/seed is idempotent and returns seeded=false on subsequent calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py — run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py -v`. Known demo barcodes: 3401597842011 (normal qty=12), 3401597842042 (low-stock qty=2), 3401597842073 (expired). Frontend routes: /, /scanner, /inventaire, /mouvements, /fournisseurs, /categories, /commandes, /alertes. All pages have data-testid attributes for navigation.
